title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Ethiopia, GOAL’s ICSP is leading to improved food security, resilient health, women’s economic empowerment and protection of communities affected by recurrent shocks and stresses in Addis Ababa, Borena, East Hararghe and Sidama. GOAL’s ICSP reached a total of 181,489 population in 2024. The programme targets vulnerable and marginalised groups including extremely poor households, youth at risk of displacement, children, vulnerable mothers, people with disabilities, and the elderly. 81% of the total program participants are women and girls. Through targeted supports, the programme is providing essential assistance, addressing critical needs and improving the well-being of vulnerable populations in the intervention areas.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome1: People Survive Crises. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Context (security and market functionality & accessibility) specific cash programming - in response to climate induced emergencies - to facilitate adaptation of livelihoods options and to promote food security.
